name: Bun cha ca tram
summary: Son River grass carp made into chả and eaten with rice noodles. One version brings fresh noodles, herbs, and a strong dipping sauce; another puts fried fish cake in broth with the noodles.
origin: Phong Nha, made with grass carp from the Son.
texture: The carp is firm and sweet.
howToEat: Dip the fish and fresh rice noodles into the strong sauce, with herbs on the side.
In the other version, the fried fish cake and noodles come in a broth.
seoTitle: Bun cha ca tram — two ways with Son River carp
seoDescription: Bún chả cá trắm pairs Son River grass carp with rice noodles, either with herbs and a strong dipping sauce or as fried fish cake in broth.
